Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to dance and sing. One day, her daddy told her that they were going on a trip to a faraway place. Lily was excited!

She put on her favorite dress and practiced putting on her clothes. Then, she put on her favorite dress to dance. She looked in the mirror and smiled.

On the trip, Lily's daddy told her they were going on a trip. They were going to see the big city and all looked so pretty in Lily's fancy dress. They were very happy and couldn't wait to go
